extension.news:
6.0.2 (2026-10-10) - tiles layout: "See more" at the end of the rows, full-height playing wave, rows follow the queue, playing wave no longer shown on a whole row while the settings are open
TILES LAYOUT: the home rows now end with a "See more" card (orange arrow) when they are full or SoundCloud has more, like the sections of the list layout; it opens the row's own page (grid with Next page), and Back returns to the row. The playing wave on the tiles now dims the cover and bounces five orange bars over almost its whole height instead of a small chip at the bottom. The rows (and the page grid) follow the queue: when the next track starts, its tile is brought into view and marked. The old follow logic compared the plugin URL with the resolved stream URL Kodi reports, so it never matched; tracks are now matched by their SoundCloud id in every list, and a list you are browsing is not yanked back to the playing track.
SETTINGS OPEN: with the settings (or any dialog) open over the interface, a whole row - typically Playlists or Following - showed the playing wave. Kodi reads a plain Window.Property inside a list from the topmost dialog, where the playing marker is empty, which matched every item that has no marker. The marker now lives on the Home window and the skin reads it from there, so the right tile keeps its wave whatever dialog is open.
6.0.1 (2026-10-10) - "OAuth token" window with Save and instant check, token entry moved from the side menu to Settings, browser extension 1.2.0, "Mixed for you" fixed (play history endpoint), playing marker reset after a single play
OAUTH TOKEN WINDOW: Settings > Account > "Manage the OAuth token..." opens a dedicated window showing the saved token (masked) and whether SoundCloud accepts it, with your username and plan. "Enter token" opens the keyboard: type or paste the token by hand, or let the "SoundCloud token for Kodi" browser extension type it for you. "Save" checks the token against SoundCloud first and keeps it only when it is valid - the result (valid / refused / check impossible) shows at once. When SoundCloud cannot be reached you choose whether to save it unchecked. "Delete" forgets the saved token. The raw token field is no longer shown in the settings; a read-only "Token status" line sums up the last check. Pasted tokens are cleaned (quotes, "OAuth " prefix, spaces). The full-screen interface reloads its home rows by itself when the token changes, and forgets that the previous token had expired - no restart needed. A single 401 is retried once before the token is called refused; a 403 (SoundCloud anti-bot or region filter) counts as "could not check", so you can still save the token. Opened from Add-ons > SoundCloud > Configure, the window closes the add-on information screen so it cannot write the old token back. The "OAuth token" button of the side menu is gone - the token is managed from Settings only.
BROWSER EXTENSION 1.2.0 (Firefox 128+, Chrome 121+): picks up the token while you use soundcloud.com, checks it, and sends it to Kodi over JSON-RPC - it presses "Enter token" in the open window and types into the keyboard only after checking its title. The help page (theworms.github.io/kodi-addon-soundcloud/get-token.html) was rewritten around the extension; the console snippet is gone, the Network tab, cookie and Python-script methods remain as fallbacks.
MIXED FOR YOU: the play history was read from /me/play-history, an endpoint that only records and clears plays, so it came back empty: "Recently played" and "Mixed for you" both fell back to the same trending list. It is now read from /me/play-history/tracks; "Mixed for you" is built from it (related tracks of your recent plays), then from SoundCloud's personalized shelf, and falls back to trending only when you are signed out or have no history yet. Unexpected answers are logged at WARNING level. Cached personalized answers are now tied to the token, so another account never gets the previous one's shelves.
PLAYING MARKERS: the orange marker is no longer left on a track after a single play ends or fails; the marker hint is honoured only while something plays or for 15 seconds after a play starts, and the watchdog clears it when that time runs out.
6.0.0 (2026-10-10) - quick settings, endless playback, sleep timer, likes from the addon, list layout, stations and personalized home rows, simplified mini-player and configurable screensaver, read-only client ID display, playback freeze fix, see more per home row, header band removed, one-press menu-to-content focus, orange playing duration and category titles, playing-cover wave, mini-player clear of the side menu, playing markers in sync, stations right under "Likes" in the side menu, mixed-for-you row rebuilt from play history, token button, reliable playing markers, stability and security fixes
STABILITY AND SECURITY (audit fixes): the fullscreen "now playing" overlay is now built on Kodi's application thread and only shown by the delay timer, so its keys work again (Back closes it, arrows seek, the progress bar runs) and it can no longer open on top of the settings screen or the virtual keyboard, stay open after the queue ends, or pop up on the Kodi home screen after the interface was closed. All background threads (progress updater, sleep timer, screensaver timer, marker watchdog) now stop when the interface closes or Kodi shuts down - no more leaked threads, no more "script didn't stop in 5 seconds" kill at shutdown. API request paths are validated before the OAuth token is attached, so the token can no longer be sent to a forged host through a crafted plugin URL. API and plugin error responses (network down, expired URLs, malformed payloads, missing track) no longer crash - they return empty results or a failed resolution instead. The client ID resolution for the read-only display now runs once per interface open in the background, with a one-hour failure cache, instead of before every plugin call. The orphaned api_public test was removed and the settings mock fixed, so the test suite runs green again.
INTERFACE FIX: the "Stations" entry now sits directly under "Likes" in the side menu (it was below "Following"), and the "Mixed for you" home row is rebuilt locally from your play history - each recently played track seeds a related-tracks request, deduplicated against the history itself - so it no longer shows the same content as "Recently played". Root cause: SoundCloud localizes the /mixed-selections shelf titles and names the personalized shelves with underscores, which the keyword match missed, so both rows silently fell back to the same trending list; section matching now ignores dashes and underscores, which also repairs the "Based on what you like" row.
TOKEN: new "OAuth token" button in the side menu, right above Settings - guided token renewal without leaving the interface: it shows the helper-page instructions (theworms.github.io copy-paste snippet), lets you paste the fresh token with the on-screen keyboard, verifies it against SoundCloud right away and reloads the home content. A dead token makes every personal row (likes, recently played, mixed for you, based on...) silently fall back to trending, which looks like duplicated rows - renew the token and they come apart. The invalid-token latch and the cached profile are cleared automatically, no Kodi restart needed.
PLAYING MARKERS: the in-progress indicators (orange title/duration, cover wave) no longer rely on ListItem.IsPlaying, which never fires for plugin-resolved playback - the skin now matches a per-item playing_marker property against the window's playing-marker id, synced from the Kodi music playlist (the source of truth for queue, autoplay and remote Next/Previous changes), with a watchdog thread as backstop when the Player callbacks are lost. Marker refresh failures now log at WARNING level.
STATIONS: new "Stations" entry in the side menu, under "Following" - lists the genre stations served by SoundCloud's discover feed (All genres, Techno, House, Hip-hop, Pop, Electronic, R&B, Ambient, ...) and, with an OAuth token, the stations you liked. Selecting a station opens its track list.
HOME ROWS: five new configurable home rows - "Recently played" (your SoundCloud play history, OAuth), "Mixed for you", "Based on what you like", "Created by SoundCloud" (curated selections) and "Buzzing artists" (playlists from the artists-to-watch selection). The personal selections are looked up at runtime in the discover feed and gracefully fall back to trending when SoundCloud does not serve them (e.g. anonymous use).
INTERFACE: activating a selection or station card/row now opens it - stations resolve through /system-playlists/<urn> and other selections through the discover endpoint; selection items previously did nothing when clicked.
INTERFACE: the playing-track equalizer is wider - eleven accent-orange bars spanning the row up to the duration column, bouncing in sequence.
MINI-PLAYER: the setting now offers only two choices - "Hidden" (the content lists stretch to the full screen height, no black strip at the bottom) or "Compact bar" (cover + title + progress bar). The old "Display + controls" mode was removed; a stored value falls back to the compact bar. The home rows scroll under the bar when it is shown.
SCREENSAVER: the fullscreen "Now Playing" overlay is now a real screensaver: a new on/off toggle hides the style and delay settings when disabled, and a configurable delay (immediate, 5, 10, 30 seconds, 1 or 2 minutes) postpones the overlay after playback starts instead of taking over the screen the moment a track begins. Default: 30 seconds.
INTERFACE: the interface loses its top band - the page header sits higher and the home rows and page lists start higher and reach further down (both layouts, with or without the mini-player), and the tile rows are taller with more air between the cards.
INTERFACE: the genre chips were removed from the home page - they duplicated the "Trending genre" addon setting, which stays the single place to pick the genre (still applied live when leaving the settings: rows and lists refresh immediately).
INTERFACE: the title and artist of the track currently playing are now accent orange in every list and card row - skins mark the playing item as "selected" and some skins (Arctic Zephyr mods in particular) paint that text pink; the addon now forces its own orange.
SETTINGS: the Account section now shows the API client ID actually in use, as a read-only row placed above the OAuth token field. The value is resolved automatically at every add-on start (custom override, 24-hour cache, or live extraction from soundcloud.com) and displays whether you browse anonymously or with a token; it cannot be edited there. The editable expert-level override stays in the Advanced group.
SETTINGS: the mini-player option is now simply "Show" or "Hide" - the compact bar with cover, title and progress bar, or the content using the full screen height.
PLAYBACK FIX: the addon could freeze Kodi completely during playback (frozen UI, no sound, only a restart recovers) - the track-end handler (premature-stream auto-resume, endless-queue extension) ran network requests and player.play() inside Kodi's own player callback, which can deadlock the application thread. The work now runs on a background thread and the callback returns immediately; the fullscreen overlay with a zero delay also opens via the timer thread instead of the callback.
INTERFACE: the page header band at the top of the content area (page title, subtitle and the orange accent line) has been removed - the content now starts near the top of the screen and gains about 140 pixels of height on every page; the side menu already shows where you are.
INTERFACE: each home section (list layout) now ends with a "See more" row when the section filled its limit - it opens the row's dedicated page with the full list and the standard "Next page" pagination (Likes, Trending, Recently played, Mixed for you, Based on what you like, Curated, Buzzing, Playlists, Following).
API FIX: an OAuth token pasted by mistake into the expert "Client ID" override field is now detected and ignored (client IDs are short alphanumeric keys, tokens contain dashes) - the read-only client ID row shows the real ID again and anonymous fallback requests work again in that situation.
INTERFACE FIX: entering the content from the side menu now takes a single Right press in every situation - the menu buttons now target the first visible home row (tiles layout) or the page content instead of a possibly hidden row, and in list layout the home list no longer lands the focus invisibly on a section header (it skips straight to the first playable row).
INTERFACE: visual polish - the tiles home row titles are now orange like the other accents; in the list layouts the title and the duration of the track currently playing are now orange in every state (not only while its row is selected), and the cover of the playing track carries a small animated wave; the Settings entry sits at the very bottom of the side menu.
INTERFACE FIX: the Settings entry at the very bottom of the side menu was covered by the mini-player bar, which spanned the whole width of the screen bottom - the bar (cover, title, progress) now starts right of the side menu, so the menu column and its Settings entry stay visible and usable whenever the bar is shown.
INTERFACE FIX: the playing indicators (orange title and duration, cover wave) were frozen on the previous track when playback changed via the remote, the mini-player or autoplay, and did not appear at all in a layout that was hidden while playback started - every list is now re-rendered when the playing track changes, when playback stops, and right after a tiles/list layout switch, so the indicators always match what is actually playing.
SETTINGS: new Playback options - configurable seek interval (5/10/15/30 s) for the arrow keys in the fullscreen player, option to skip 30-second Go+ excerpts, endless playback, and a sleep timer (15/30/60/120 min) that counts EFFECTIVE listening time (pause suspends the countdown).
DISPLAY: the Trending row and the trending widget now follow a configurable genre (All genres, Techno, House, Deep House, Electronic, Hip-hop, Ambient, Jazz).
INTERFACE: new home layout option "List" (side menu + a vertical list of trending tracks, one track per line with cover, artist and duration, and clickable genre chips above the list). The old "Rows only" layout was REMOVED - it hid the side menu, which also hid the only in-addon access to the settings, trapping the user; the side menu is now always visible and a stale "rows" setting value falls back to the cards layout. Layout and mini-player changes apply immediately when leaving the addon settings, without closing and reopening the interface. INTERFACE FIX: the "List" home layout did not show its genre chips and trending list when the addon was OPENED directly in list mode (fresh open). The group's skin visibility condition used parentheses, which Kodi's boolean expression parser rejects (two "unmatched parentheses" errors at every window load, leaving the whole group unrendered). Rewrote the condition flat ("A + B | A + C", AND binds tighter than OR - no parentheses). Opening the addon directly in list mode now shows the chips and the list. INTERFACE: the vertical list mode now applies to EVERY page - likes, playlists, subscriptions, search results and playlist contents - not just the home screen. Both the card panel and the vertical list are always filled with the same content, so switching layouts from the settings refocuses the matching list live, without re-fetching or reopening. INTERFACE: the home list rows now follow the design demo - one compact card per track (dark #252525 background, focused row #2E2E2E) with a 56x56 cover, white title, grey artist and right-aligned grey duration; the focused track title turns accent orange. INTERFACE: the "List" home page now shows one section per configured home row (Likes / Trending / Playlists / Subscriptions, same row settings as the tiles layout; rows set to "off" are skipped) under orange localized headers - previously it only listed trending tracks and the row settings had no effect in list mode. INTERFACE: list rows on every page are taller and less compact - 110px rows with an 84x84 cover and larger fonts (title, artist, duration), same demo styling (dark card, focused row highlighted in #2E2E2E, orange focused title). INTERFACE: the home genre chips are now shown in BOTH layouts - the tiles home previously had no way to pick the trending genre from the home page. The chips sit above the content; the tiles rows moved down to make room. INTERFACE: selecting a side-menu entry no longer auto-jumps the focus into the content - it stays on the menu and you move to the content yourself (right / down). A fresh open focuses the Home button of the side menu. INTERFACE: the track currently playing shows a pulsing orange equalizer on its row in the list layouts. INTERFACE: the home genre chips bar now sits right under the page title and is only shown when a Trending row is configured (the genre only affects trending content) - no trending row, no chips bar. INTERFACE: changing the home row order/types in the settings now applies immediately when leaving the settings, like the layout and genre - no window reopen needed. INTERFACE: the playing-track equalizer is larger (six bars spanning up to the duration) and stays full-strength accent orange at all times - it now bounces instead of fading, which washed the colour out and read as pink on some displays. INTERFACE FIX: the mini-player is now reachable with the remote - down from the last item of any content list / the last home row reaches the play/pause button, up from the buttons returns to the content - and its play/pause button showed an empty block instead of an icon: the icon is now kept in sync by the addon (play when paused, pause bars when playing). SETTINGS: the layout options are renamed to "Tiles" and "List" (a stale stored value still falls back to tiles).
EXPERT: cache duration (7/30/90 days, old entries purged once per session) and network timeout (5/10/15/30 s) are now settings instead of hardcoded values.
LIKES: long-press (context menu) on any track now offers "Add to likes" / "Remove from likes" - no need to open soundcloud.com anymore. Requires an OAuth token.
ENDLESS PLAYBACK: when the queue reaches its last track, related tracks are fetched from SoundCloud and appended automatically, so the music never stops. The extension is defensive: if the related-tracks endpoint ever changes, the option silently becomes a no-op (watch kodi.log).
WIDGET MODE REMOVED: the "Home screen widget" setting has been deleted. When it was set to a category (Likes / Playlists / Following / Trending / Discover), EVERY open of the addon was hijacked into that flat widget listing instead of the interface — with no way back to it, and the stored value survives reinstalls in the addon data. The plugin root now always behaves the same: a user open launches the full interface, a skin home widget gets the widget shortcut list. Skin widgets that need a track list should point at the direct /widget/<category>/ paths instead of the addon root.
5.9.6027 (2026-10-08) - robustness fixes (audit) CHARTS: /charts returns an empty listing on an unexpected API response (error page, rate limit) instead of crashing with KeyError.
API PUBLIC: ApiPublic requests are wrapped in try/except (network error, non-JSON response) - no more crashes on transport failures, consistent with ApiV2.
SEARCH HISTORY: a corrupted search_history.json (interrupted write) no longer crashes the plugin at startup; the default value is used instead.
LOGS: timing lines (T+Xms) and HTTP body previews move from LOGINFO to LOGDEBUG to keep kodi.log clean for users.
5.9.6026 (2026-08-13) - network timeouts + cache housekeeping NETWORK TIMEOUTS: every API request now has a bounded timeout (5s connect, 15s response). Previously a silent/unreachable SoundCloud endpoint could freeze the full-screen UI for minutes (OS-level TCP timeout) with no visual feedback, since API calls run on the GUI thread. On timeout or network error the addon now logs a warning and returns an empty collection instead of hanging.
SERVICE PRELOAD FIX: the background service warmed a stale file list referencing modules that no longer exist (listItems.py, objects.py) — silently skipped, so two of the heaviest modules were never pre-cached. The list now matches the real tree (kodi/items.py, plugin.py included).
CACHE HOUSEKEEPING: special://temp is NOT purged between sessions on CoreELEC/LibreELEC, so blurred-cover images accumulated forever; they are now pruned after 30 days (once per process). Expired API cache entries are also deleted on read instead of lingering on disk.
5.9.6025 (2026-07-02) - auto-resume interrupted streams + clean shutdown STREAM AUTO-RESUME: SoundCloud's progressive stream URLs are signed CloudFront links with an expiry. On very long tracks (hour-plus mixes), the signature can expire mid-play: Kodi's file cache then reads 0 bytes, retries the same dead URL for minutes ("source read returned 0! Will retry" spam), and finally gives up — ending the track prematurely (a real-world log showed a 67-minute mix dying at 71%). The player observer now detects "ended" events that occur more than 60 seconds before the track's real duration, restarts the same playlist position (which re-resolves a FRESH stream URL with a new track_authorization JWT and CloudFront signature through our /play/ handler), and seeks back to ~5 seconds before the interruption. Max 2 attempts per track to avoid loops; a "Stream interrupted — resuming…" notification is shown. The rest of the queue is preserved.
CLEAN SHUTDOWN: quitting Kodi while the SoundCloud UI was open logged "script didn't stop in 5 seconds - let's kill it" followed by a Python SystemExit traceback — the modal home window kept the script alive until Kodi force-killed it. A tiny daemon thread now watches for Kodi shutdown (Monitor.waitForAbort) and closes the window, letting the script exit cleanly within the grace period.
5.9.6024 (2026-07-02) - widget playback continues with the category When a track launched from a skin home widget ends, playback now continues with the other tracks from the same widget category (Likes / Trending / Discover) instead of stopping on a silent black screen.
How it works: the widget click now carries its category (source=likes|trending|discover) through the whole chain (widget item URL → plugin root → RunScript → home window). On startup, the home window fetches the category's track list, finds the clicked track in it, and queues the WHOLE list into Kodi's music playlist with the clicked track first — same mechanism as clicking a track on the home rows, shuffle setting honoured. If the clicked track has dropped off the category's first page since the widget rendered, it is fetched individually and prepended.
New setting: Playback > "Continue with widget category after track ends" (default ON). Turn it off to get the previous single-track behaviour. Internal refactor: the playlist-queueing block moved from _play_with_queue into a shared _queue_and_play used by both the home-row click path and the widget startup path.
5.9.6023 (2026-07-02) - widget tracks open the full UI + overlay GUI error fixes WIDGET CLICK-THROUGH: clicking a track in a skin home widget (Likes / Trending / Discover) now opens the full SoundCloud interface with that track playing — home window, mini-player and now-playing overlay included — instead of handing the stream to Kodi's bare native player. Implementation: widget track items now point at the plugin root with a play_track=<id> parameter; the root handler launches the UI via RunScript passing the track id through to the home window, which resolves the track (api resolve_id) and starts playback right after its initial population. Playlist and artist widget items are unchanged (they navigate as folders).
OVERLAY GUI FIXES (probable freeze/crash factors): all four now-playing overlays (cinema, editorial, vinyl, waveform) had two latent GUI bugs visible as repeated errors in kodi.log: 1. Seven "Conditional" animations were missing their condition attribute — Kodi logs "Control has invalid animation type (no condition or no type)" and DISCARDS the animation. Added condition="true" everywhere (matching the splash spinner, which was already correct). Side effect: the cinema Ken Burns zoom and vinyl rotation now actually animate on setups where they silently didn't. 2. defaultcontrol pointed at control 9001, which is a label — labels can't take focus, so Kodi retried forever, spamming "Control 9001 ... has been asked to focus, but it can't" every few seconds for the whole playback. Each overlay now contains an invisible 1x1 off-screen button (id 9099) as the focus sink; key presses still reach onAction as before.
5.9.6022 (2026-07-01) - migrate ListItem.setInfo() → InfoTagMusic Kodi 20 (Nexus) deprecated the old setInfo('music', ...) dict API in favour of typed setters on InfoTagMusic. Kodi 21 Omega spammed kodi.log with "Setting most music properties through ListItem.setInfo() is deprecated" on every track, playlist, artist and selection we returned. Kodi 22 may remove the old API entirely.
All four models migrated: Track, Playlist, User (artist), Selection. New calls use list_item.getMusicInfoTag() plus typed setters (setTitle, setArtist, setAlbum, setDuration, setGenres, setComment, setListeners, setYear, setReleaseDate, setMediaType).
Type-strictness fixes that came with the migration: - setDuration wants int (in seconds). We were passing a float from the ms→s division; explicit int() cast added. - setGenres wants a LIST of strings, not a single string. We wrap the API's single-string genre in a one-element list. - setPlayCount used to receive SoundCloud's public playback_count. Semantically wrong: setPlayCount is "times YOU played this track" and marks it as watched in Kodi. Switched to setListeners which is the correct semantic for a public popularity counter. - setReleaseDate wants "YYYY-MM-DD"; SoundCloud gives ISO datetimes like "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z". We truncate to the date part.
Zero functional change on the UI side — same fields are populated, same values shown. Just no more log spam and future-proofed for Kodi 22.
5.9.6021 (2026-06-29) - readme trimmed Removed the "What's new in v5.9" section from both readme.md and readme.fr.md — the sub-release notes were too noisy for a user-facing README. Kept two persistent features (token helper page, account tier detection) as bullets under "What's new in v5" where they fit alongside the broader v5 architecture changes. Everything else (splash timings, service internals, keyboard shortcuts, Free-tier fix) is still documented in the individual news entries below and in this addon.xml history.
5.9.6020 (2026-06-29) - widgets now show real artwork, not generic icons Two related bugs in the artwork extraction were causing skin widgets (Likes, Playlists, Following, Trending, Discover) to fall back to Kodi's default icons for many items:
BUG 1: dict.get() default ignored on explicit null. SoundCloud commonly returns "artwork_url": null when a track or playlist doesn't have a custom cover. Python's dict.get("artwork_url", fallback) returns the explicit None, NOT the fallback — so the chain to avatar_url was never reached. Switched to "or" chaining which treats nulls and missing keys the same way.
BUG 2: tracks without artwork had no fallback at all. soundcloud.com itself falls back to the uploading artist's avatar (track.user.avatar_url) when a track has no cover. We now do the same. Result: every track widget tile gets a meaningful image — either the track's own artwork or the artist's avatar.
This affects all artwork extraction across the addon: home screen, widgets, search results, playlists, the now-playing overlay. Tracks and playlists that previously showed generic Kodi icons should now display the artist's avatar at minimum.
5.9.6019 (2026-06-29) - multilingual readme (EN + FR) Updated the readme.md to cover all the v5.9.6xxx features: background service, splash screen, Free-tier playback fix, account tier detection, keyboard shortcuts in Now Playing, and the updated launching options. Also bumped the Kodi version badge from v19 Matrix to v21 Omega.
Added readme.fr.md as a full French translation. Both files have a language switcher at the top. German and Dutch translations to follow.
5.9.6018 (2026-06-29) - service opt-in by default + create-favourite removed Three changes based on user feedback after testing 5.9.6017:
SERVICE OFF BY DEFAULT: the background service is now disabled out of the box. Users who want the faster open have to opt in via Settings > Account > "Background service (faster open)" and then restart Kodi. Defaults to off so users on low-RAM boxes don't unknowingly consume memory. The help text now says "REQUIRES A KODI RESTART after toggling" explicitly. To make this even harder to miss: when plugin.py is invoked and detects the service is enabled but not actually running (the service hasn't set its "alive" property), it shows a one-shot notification reminding the user to restart Kodi.
CREATE-FAVOURITE BUTTON REMOVED: the "Create Kodi favourite" button in settings was crashing on some setups (likely because we called ReloadSkin() from within a plugin handler, which Kodi doesn't like). Removed the button from the UI. Users wanting a favourite can use the standard Kodi long-press / context menu on the addon in the music browser, then "Add to favourites" — works reliably across all skins. The underlying handler stays in plugin.py for any existing favourites that point at it.
SERVICE.PRELOAD LOGIC: changed from "true unless explicitly 'false'" to "false unless explicitly 'true'". This means the service stays off until the user makes a conscious choice to enable it.
5.9.6017 (2026-06-29) - background service for instant splash (EmbyCon-inspired) Looking at how EmbyCon (plugin.video.embycon) starts up gave the idea for this release. They run a small xbmc.service from Kodi login until Kodi shutdown, which keeps things warm in the background. We adapted the approach for our specific bottleneck: the splash window.
What it does: - service.py starts at Kodi login and runs in the background - At startup, it reads our heavy Python module files into the OS page cache (so cold imports are faster the first time the user opens the addon) - It then polls every 50ms for a window property "soundcloud.splash" - When plugin.py is invoked (user clicks the addon), it sets that property to "show" — the service picks it up within ~50ms and displays the splash window - When script.py finishes loading and is ready to open the home, it sets the property to "hide" — the service closes the splash
Net effect: the splash appears within ~50ms of the click instead of ~330ms (waiting for script.py to cold-start). No more music browser flash for users who launch via Music > Add-ons > Run.
Memory cost: a few MB of resident Python interpreter, plus the splash window when it's actually displayed. Disable via Settings > Account > "Background service (faster open)" if you're on a low-RAM device.

5.9.6016 (2026-06-29) - critical: UnboundLocalError on every plugin call (5.9.6014/15 regression) The create-favourite handler added in 5.9.6014 did `addon_id = addon.getAddonInfo("id")` inside the run() function. Python sees ANY assignment to a name inside a function as making that name local for the WHOLE function body — even references that happen BEFORE the assignment line. So when an earlier code path (the launch-UI section, line 136) did `xbmc.executebuiltin("RunScript(" + addon_id + ")")`, Python raised UnboundLocalError because the local `addon_id` wasn't bound yet.
Fix: dropped the redundant local assignment and use the module-level `addon_id` directly (it's the same value). Also added a static analysis pass to the build that walks the AST of plugin.py and warns if any function re-assigns a module global — so this whole category of bug can't slip through again.

5.9.6015 (2026-06-29) - bridge the bootstrap with Kodi's busy dialog The 5.9.6014 log showed the music browser was still visible for ~500ms between click and splash, even though our splash itself was rendering fast. Between T+0 and T+330ms the music browser was the only thing on screen.
Fix: plugin.py now activates Kodi's NATIVE busy dialog at T+0ms — before launching RunScript. The busy dialog is owned by Kodi (not by our Python script), so it survives the death of plugin.py and stays visible until script.py reaches the point where our pretty SoundCloud splash takes over. Right after script.py shows the splash, it closes the busy dialog. The transition busy → splash is essentially seamless.
Net result: instead of 500ms of music browser visible, you now see a Kodi spinner for ~300ms (matches the skin look), then the SoundCloud splash with the orange ring, then the home. No more music browser flash.

plugin.py: T+0ms run() entry plugin.py: T+Xms after RunScript() call plugin.py: T+Xms plugin.py exiting script.py: T+0ms script.py entry script.py: T+Xms after Dialog.Close + ReplaceWindow script.py: T+Xms addon loaded script.py: T+Xms all modules imported script.py: T+Xms API/settings/cache constructed script.py: T+Xms calling open_home() window.py: SoundCloudHomeWindow onInit (skin XML loaded)
Install this version, open the addon, then send the log lines containing "timing T+". The delta between plugin.py exit and script.py entry tells us if Kodi's Python invoker is queueing scripts (likely culprit when other plugins like embycon are loading in parallel). The delta between script.py entry and onInit tells us how long imports + XML parsing take.

5.9.6005 (2026-06-29) - api: Origin/Referer headers + auth test cascade + tier detection Three fixes diagnosed by testing endpoints directly from a browser console:
API HEADERS: SoundCloud's edge started returning HTTP 403 on /me (and 404 on /me/play-history) for requests that don't look like they come from soundcloud.com. The fix: every api-v2 request now sends Origin: https://soundcloud.com and Referer: https://soundcloud.com/ headers alongside the OAuth token. With these headers in place, /me works, /users/{id}/* works, and the addon no longer relies on endpoints SoundCloud has been quietly removing.
AUTH TEST: rewrote the "Test OAuth token" cascade. It now hits /me first (with proper browser headers — should work for everyone), and if that fails, falls back to /users/{my_id}/track_likes which is the same endpoint used for the Likes home row. As long as ANY of these returns 200, auth is confirmed.
ACCOUNT TIER DETECTION: when /me returns 200, the addon now reads consumer_subscription.product.id and displays it in the success dialog ("Account: Free", "Account: Go+", "Account: Pro Unlimited"). The tier is also persisted in settings under account.tier for future use (filter Preview tracks for Free accounts, expose Pro-only options, etc).
5.9.6004 (2026-06-29) - playback fixed + auth test fixed + help dialog simplified Three real bugs diagnosed from a user log:
PLAYBACK: every track was failing with HTTP 404 on its /media/.../stream/progressive URL, causing Kodi to skip through the entire playlist. Root cause: since 2025, SoundCloud requires a `track_authorization` query parameter (a JWT, valid ~2h) on stream URLs IN ADDITION to the OAuth token in the Authorization header. We were only passing the OAuth token. Fixed: read `track_authorization` from each track object and stitch it onto the transcoding URL at extraction time.
AUTH TEST: the "Test OAuth token" button always failed with HTTP 403 even for fully-valid tokens, because SoundCloud started blocking the /me endpoint specifically. Other user-scoped endpoints (/me/track_likes, /me/play-history, /users/{id}/...) still work fine. Switched the test to hit /me/play-history?limit=1 instead, then optimistically tries /me afterwards to enrich the success message with the username (but doesn't fail if /me is blocked). Added a new generic success message (string 30246) for when we can't get the username but auth is confirmed working.
HELP DIALOG: the "How to get a token" button in settings used to show a long step-by-step text. Replaced with a short message pointing to the web helper page (https://theworms.github.io/kodi-addon-soundcloud/) which now does all the work — both the automatic snippet and the manual fallback method are documented there.
5.9.6003 (2026-06-29) - helper page snippet: minification bugfix (URLs no longer eaten) The console snippet on the helper page was broken by a bug in its own minification: the regex stripping line comments (//...) was also matching the // in URLs like https://api-v2.soundcloud.com/... and truncating the source. 5.9.6002 (2026-06-29) - helper page: multi-strategy token discovery + manual method as first-class The previous snippet only hooked window.fetch and triggered /me, which often failed silently because SoundCloud's frontend caches the fetch reference at startup — patching it after the snippet runs doesn't intercept their requests. New approach searches multiple places in order: 1) document.cookie, 2) localStorage values, 3) sessionStorage values, 4) hook fetch+XHR and trigger /me/track_likes as last resort.
Verbose console output at every step so the user can see exactly what is happening: "[SC] Step 1/4 cookies: miss", "[SC] Step 2/4 localStorage (47 keys): HIT", "[SC] Token found: 2-XXXXXX...". Token is also printed in green in the console so even if the popup fails, the user can copy from there. Both an alert() AND a custom DOM popup are tried (alert is a guaranteed fallback if the popup creation fails).
The manual Network-tab method is now documented as a full first-class section on the helper page (not hidden in a fallback details/summary), with the clear honest note that SoundCloud sometimes keeps the token out of reach for scripts and the manual method is the reliable fallback.

5.7.3 (2026-04-26) - diagnostic Logs detailed window/context info on every root call so we can identify why the widget/UI auto-detection fails on Arctic Zephyr Reloaded. Look for "ROOT context diag" lines in kodi.log.
5.7.2 (2026-04-26) - smart UI auto-launch Auto-detect whether the addon is being called by a skin home widget (data fetch — return a directory) or by the user clicking the addon (open the full UI). Detection is based on whether the Kodi Home screen is active. Fixes the regression where users had to click "▶ Open SoundCloud" every time after 5.7.1.
5.7.1 (2026-04-26) - widget compatibility fix Fixed: skin home widgets (Arctic Zephyr Reloaded, etc.) used to launch the full-screen UI when added — kicking the user out of their home screen. The addon root URL now returns a flat directory listing of widget shortcuts, so widgets show actual content. Users clicking on the addon from Kodi's add-on browser see a "▶ Open SoundCloud" entry as the first item to launch the full UI.
5.7.0 (2026-04-26) - simplification Removed the classic plugin-style menu — the full-screen UI is now the only interface. Removes 75 lines of code, the "Auto-launch" setting, the ?legacy=1 escape hatch and the /launch-ui/ route. Skin home widgets continue to work via the dedicated /widget/* routes (independent of the menu). The "Off" option in Widget mode now shows the full UI instead of the classic menu.
5.6.1 (2026-04-26) - widget mode for Arctic Zephyr Arctic Zephyr Reloaded only lets widgets point at the addon root, so the previous /widget/likes/ etc. routes weren't reachable through its UI. Added a "Widget mode" setting (Settings > Display > Skin home widget) that changes what the root returns. Pick Likes / Playlists / Following / Trending / Discover and the home widget will display that. Use ?legacy=1 to keep accessing the menu.
5.6.0 (2026-04-26) - skin widgets Added 5 widget shortcut routes that any skin can target as a flat directory: /widget/likes/, /widget/playlists/, /widget/following/, /widget/trending/, /widget/discover/. A new "Widgets" entry in the classic plugin menu lets you browse them from a skin's "Add Widget" picker. See the readme for the Arctic Zephyr Reloaded setup procedure.
5.5.14 (2026-04-25) - progress bar fix v3 Progress bar updater is now started AFTER the GUI is built (in onInit) instead of in __init__ — that's why no setWidth() calls were being made. Added explicit logging so we can verify the thread is running and the values are being computed. Look for "ProgressUpdater" lines in kodi.log.
5.5.13 (2026-04-25) - progress bar v3 Progress bar now resized directly via Python control.setWidth() instead of relying on $INFO[Window.Property] in XML width (which Kodi doesn't re-evaluate per frame). The orange fill image has a fixed XML id and the background thread calls setWidth() every 500ms with the computed pixel width. This works regardless of skin or audio format.
5.5.12 (2026-04-25) - custom progress bar Replaced the native Kodi progress bar (which was hijacked by Arctic Zephyr Reloaded's blue styling and frozen for HLS streams) with two stacked custom images. A background Python thread polls the player position every 500ms and updates the orange fill width via Window.Property. This fixes both the "always blue" and "never moves" issues at once.
5.5.11 (2026-04-25) Time/Duration labels in the mini-player are now wider, brighter (white instead of grey), and use a bigger font (font12) so 1:23:45-style timestamps display fully without truncation Removed unnecessary border attributes from progress bar that were causing rendering issues on some skins (orange.png is now a flat 1x1 pixel that Kodi stretches reliably)
NOTE: if the progress bar still doesn't move, check Settings > Playback > Audio format — set it to "Standard stable (MP3 progressive)" rather than "Standard adaptive (MP3 HLS)". HLS streams can prevent Player.Progress from updating on some Kodi builds.
5.5.10 (2026-04-25) Updated readme.md with the new v5 interface description and a corrected, step-by-step OAuth token procedure (using the Authorization header, with explicit warnings about the cookie pitfall)
5.5.9 (2026-04-25) Added TheWorms as a contributor (visible in Kodi's add-on info screen)
5.5.8 (2026-04-25) - progress bar fix Fixed progress bar showing as fully filled and frozen: switched midtexture to use 9-patch border rendering and added explicit empty lefttexture/righttexture/overlaytexture so Kodi correctly interpolates the fill width Resized orange.png from 4x4 to 8x8 so it survives the border="2" 9-patch slicing Progress bar now shows in SoundCloud orange (#FF5500) and updates in real-time as the track plays
5.5.7 (2026-04-25) Fixed: changes to OAuth token (or any setting) now take effect immediately without needing to restart Kodi The Settings class now creates a fresh xbmcaddon.Addon() instance on every read, bypassing Kodi's in-memory cache that was hiding the new value Auto-reset of the "token invalid" flag when the user changes the token — no more stuck 401 state after a paste
5.5.6 (2026-04-24) - diagnostic "Test OAuth token" now shows the actual error body from SoundCloud (not just the HTTP code), and logs the full request + response details to kodi.log for debugging.
5.5.5 (2026-04-24) OAuth token cleaning is now much more aggressive: strips ALL whitespace and non-printable characters anywhere in the token (not just leading/trailing). Catches Windows clipboard \r\n, zero-width spaces, BOM, etc. that were silently breaking authentication. "Test OAuth token" now displays a token preview (length + first/last chars) so you can verify the paste was clean.
5.5.4 (2026-04-24) Rewrote "How to get a token" help text — now correctly recommends the Authorization HTTP header (not the cookie). The cookie method silently fails, which is what was causing persistent 401 errors.
5.5.3 (2026-04-24) After closing SoundCloud (Back), now go straight to Kodi home instead of bouncing back to the Music files / add-ons window OAuth token field auto-strips "OAuth " or "Bearer " prefix if pasted by mistake (and surrounding quotes)
5.5.2 (2026-04-24) Added "Test OAuth token" button in Settings > Account, right below the token field — verifies the token by calling /me and shows your username on success Optimized /me handling: when the token is known invalid, skip the call entirely instead of doing 2 round-trips per UI page
5.5.1 (2026-04-24) Fixed cascade of HTTP 401 errors on public endpoints when an OAuth token is expired/invalid: the API now drops the bad token after the first 401 and retries anonymously, so charts/discover/trending keep working until the user updates the token
5.5.0 (2026-04-24) - settings reorganization Settings reorganized into 3 user-friendly categories: Display / Playback / Account Audio format options renamed to friendlier labels (Light Opus / Standard adaptive MP3 / Standard stable MP3) "Tracks per page" replaces the old "Search items size" wording (used by both search and pagination) Advanced API options (custom Client-ID, locale, search history size) moved to Expert level (use Kodi's Settings level slider to see them)
5.4.1 (2026-04-24) Fixed first card of each row being clipped on the left Fixed orange focus border persisting on rows that no longer have focus (now only the focused row shows the orange highlight) Fixed mini-player buttons rendering as empty squares (replaced Unicode chars with ASCII) Fixed progress bar showing in cyan instead of orange (dedicated orange texture instead of colordiffuse)
5.4.0 (2026-04-24) Home now has 4 configurable rows (Likes / Trending / Playlists / Following) in a vertically scrollable container Each row can be configured/reordered/disabled in Settings > Home rows Added pagination: pages now show a "Next page" item at the end when there are more results Page size honors the existing "Items per page" setting Selection now follows the playing track when autoplay moves to the next song Mini-player has a new "Compact" mode (cover + title + wide progress bar, no controls) Progress bar made thicker (8px) and properly themed in SoundCloud orange
5.3.0 (2026-04-24) Removed "Classic interface" button from sidebar — switching back to the classic UI is now done via Settings > Interface > "Use the new interface" toggle (turn it off) Sidebar now has 6 buttons: Home, Search, Likes, My playlists, Following, Settings
5.2.3 (2026-04-24) Fixed all addon-localized labels using $ADDON[plugin.audio.soundcloud XXXXX] instead of $LOCALIZE[XXXXX] (which was looking up Kodi core strings, not ours) Widened sidebar from 180px to 240px so French labels like "Vos abonnements" and "Interface classique" fit without truncation
5.2.2 (2026-04-24) DIAGNOSTIC: hardcoded sidebar labels (no $LOCALIZE) to determine why text was invisible
5.2.1 (2026-04-24) Fixed all text being invisible in the new UI (sidebar buttons, page titles, mini-player labels): removed broken custom Font.xml and switched to Kodi's standard font names guaranteed by every skin
5.2.0 (2026-04-24) Added auto-play next track: clicking a track now queues all visible tracks so Kodi plays them in sequence Added "Auto-play next track" toggle in Settings > Interface (on by default)
5.1.4 (2026-04-24) Fixed sidebar buttons appearing as solid white blocks (removed broken transparent texture) Fixed last sidebar button being cut off by the mini-player (tightened vertical layout)
5.1.3 (2026-04-24) Fixed sidebar text being invisible (explicit text positioning + better focus contrast)
5.1.2 (2026-04-24) Fixed playback interruption caused by a window reload loop after auto-launching the new UI Added re-entrancy guard to prevent stacking multiple WindowXML instances Made focus assignment defensive (no more "Control X cannot focus" warnings)
5.1.1 (2026-04-24) Fixed audio decoder crash when SoundCloud transcoding URLs expire (now properly tells Kodi to skip the track instead of feeding it a None path) Improved logging when stream URL resolution fails
5.1.0 (2026-04-24) New full-screen interface (V2): sidebar navigation, horizontal carousel rows, mini-player with controls Auto-launches by default — disable in Settings > Interface Layout (rows-only or sidebar+rows) and mini-player mode (off/display/controls) configurable in Settings Classic plugin still accessible via plugin://plugin.audio.soundcloud/?legacy=1 for widgets and fallback
5.0.3 (2026-04-24) Fixed 404 on Mon profil sub-menus: api-v2 doesn't expose /me/* sub-resources, now resolves user_id via /me and uses /users/{id}/* paths

5.0.1 (2026-04-24) Fixed authenticated /me/* endpoints returning empty collections (no client_id when authenticated) Fixed likes/reposts/playlist-likes envelope unwrapping for authenticated endpoints
4.3.0 (2026-04-24) Added experimental full-screen UI (WindowXML script) with horizontal track carousel and mini-player Launch via "New interface (beta)" from the root menu, or via RunScript(plugin.audio.soundcloud)
4.2.0 (2026-04-24) Added optional OAuth token login to access likes, playlists, following and reposts Added French translation Added proper content types per view (songs/albums/artists) so skins pick the right layout Added per-item fanart (artwork for tracks/playlists, profile banners for artists) Added sort methods on song views (title, artist, duration, playcount) Improved playlist and artist metadata (track count, follower count, mediatype) Fixed crash on tracks without a display_date
